grid.expression: SELECT TO_CHAR(LAN.DTMOV,'MM/YYYY') AS MES, LAN.DTMOV, PLA.CTACTB, LAN.CODCTACTB, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(INITCAP(PLA.DESCRCTA),' De ',' de '),' E ',' e '),'S/', 's/') AS DESCRCTA, LAN.NUMLOTE, LAN.NUMLANC, LAN.SEQUENCIA, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(INITCAP(LAN.COMPLHIST),' De ',' de '),' E ',' e '),'S/', 's/') AS COMPLHIST, (LAN.VLRLANC * CASE WHEN LAN.TIPLANC = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) AS VALOR, LAN.CODCENCUS||' - '||CUS.DESCRCENCUS AS CR, LAN.CODPROJ||' - '||PRJ.IDENTIFICACAO AS PROJETO, NVL(CAB.NUMNOTA, FIN.NUMNOTA) AS NUMNOTA, NVL(CAB.CODNAT,FIN.CODNAT)||' - '||NAT.DESCRNAT AS NATUREZA, NVL(CAB.CODPARC,FIN.CODPARC)||' - '||UPPER(PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL) AS PARCEIRO, LAN.CODEMP, CASE WHEN INT.ORIGEM = 'E' THEN 'PORTAL' WHEN INT.ORIGEM IN ('B','F') THEN 'FINANCEIRO' WHEN INT.ORIGEM = 'M' THEN 'BANCÁRIO' ELSE 'CONTABIL' END AS ORIG FROM TCBPLA PLA, TSICUS CUS, TCSPRJ PRJ, TCBLAN LAN LEFT JOIN TCBINT INT ON INT.REFERENCIA = LAN.REFERENCIA AND INT.NUMLANC = LAN.NUMLANC AND INT.SEQUENCIA = LAN.SEQUENCIA AND INT.NUMLOTE = LAN.NUMLOTE AND INT.CODEMP=LAN.CODEMP LEFT JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON INT.NUNICO = CAB.NUNOTA AND INT.ORIGEM= 'E' LEFT JOIN TGFFIN FIN ON INT.NUNICO = FIN.NUFIN AND INT.ORIGEM IN ('B','F') LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = NVL(CAB.CODPARC,FIN.CODPARC) LEFT JOIN TGFNAT NAT ON NAT.CODNAT = NVL(CAB.CODNAT,FIN.CODNAT) LEFT JOIN TCBLOT LOT ON LOT.NUMLOTE = LAN.NUMLOTE AND LOT.REFERENCIA = LAN.REFERENCIA AND LAN.CODEMP = LOT.CODEMP WHERE CUS.CODCENCUS = LAN.CODCENCUS AND PRJ.CODPROJ = LAN.CODPROJ AND LAN.DTMOV >= TO_CHAR(trunc(:DAT1,'YYYY'), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AND LAN.DTMOV <= LAST_DAY(:DAT1) AND LAN.CODCTACTB = PLA.CODCTACTB AND LAN.NUMLOTE NOT IN (999,9999) AND LAN.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND LOT.COMENTARIOS NOT LIKE 'Encerramento das Contas de Resultado%' AND LAN.CODCTACTB = :CODCTACTB AND TO_CHAR(LAN.DTMOV,'MM') = NVL(:MESTEXTO,TO_CHAR(LAN.DTMOV,'MM')) ORDER BY DTMOV DESC, COMPLHIST
